note: P is mostly one idea: Inter sans, glassy translucent buttons with a soft glow on purple-blob backgrounds (P1, P2 and P4 are near-identical dark cards or heroes), with only P3's light page and tactile-border look differing; Q mixes serif headlines, a pastel iridescent pill, a dark gradient pill and light cards, though Q3 and Q4 are close to the same light card with a gradient arrow pill, and all curves are similar expo-out easings.
